explication: KaTeX is a JavaScript TeX math-rendering library. Its main workflow accepts an expression through the public API, parses it into a tree, builds HTML and MathML representations, and returns markup or renders into a DOM element. The graph also preserves documented extensions and major parsing/layout layers. Source excerpts are partial, so some subsystem links are omitted or marked unverified rather than inferred.
